P38 command: "git config core.hooksPath '/var/folders/qp/6jqgtjs534v593qjr7hh6ssw0000gn/T/rh-probe-8b3gkh/p53-1L0wX0/.harness-state'"
P38 reason: research-harness cannot let this shell command touch the harness state directory (/var/folders/qp/6jqgtjs534v593qjr7hh6ssw0000gn/T/rh-probe-8b3gkh/p53-1L0wX0/.harness-state): it holds the sealing key
P39 command: "tar -xf attack.tar"
P40 command: "unzip -o attack.zip"
P41 command: "printf x >> research/../research/decisions.md"
P41 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P42 command: "printf x >> shortcut/decisions.md"
P42 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P43 command: "printf x >> shortcut/name"
P43 reason: research-harness cannot let this shell command touch the harness state directory (/var/folders/qp/6jqgtjs534v593qjr7hh6ssw0000gn/T/rh-probe-8b3gkh/p58-8g6F3X/.harness-state): it holds the sealing key
P44 command: "printf x >> RESEARCH/decisions.md"
P44 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P45 command: "printf x >> researсh/decisions.md"
P46 command: "printf x >> research/./decisions.md"
P46 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P47 command: "printf x >> research/decisions.md/"
P47 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P48 command: "printf x >> research//decisions.md"
P48 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P49 command: "printf x >> '/var/folders/qp/6jqgtjs534v593qjr7hh6ssw0000gn/T/rh-probe-8b3gkh/p64-TDTubS/research/decisions.md'"
P49 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P50 command: "printf x >> ~/research/decisions.md"
P51 command: "printf x >> \"$PWD/research/decisions.md\""
P51 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into a path assembled at runtime. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/r
P52 command: "cd research && cd .. && printf x >> \"$OLDPWD/decisions.md\""
P52 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into a path assembled at runtime. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/r
P53 command: "ln -s research shortcut && printf x >> shortcut/decisions.md"
P53 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and `ln` is not a read-only command. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/init, an
P54 command: "ln -s .harness-state shortcut && printf x >> shortcut/name"
P54 reason: research-harness cannot let this shell command touch the harness state directory (/var/folders/qp/6jqgtjs534v593qjr7hh6ssw0000gn/T/rh-probe-8b3gkh/p69-ay5T93/.harness-state): it holds the sealing key
P55 command: "printf x >> hop/decisions.md"
P55 reason: Only read-only shell access to the research state is allowed, and it redirects into the research state. Reads that pass: cat, grep, sed -n, git diff/log/show/status, research-harness status/review/ini
P56 command: "node -e 'require(\"fs\").appendFileSync([\"resear\"+\"ch\",\"decis\"+\"ions.md\"].join(\"/\"),\"SQ-322\\n\")'"
P57 command: "python3 -c 'open(\"resear\"+\"ch/decis\"+\"ions.md\",\"a\").write(\"SQ-322\\n\")'"
P58 command: "node -e 'require(\"fs\").appendFileSync(require(\"path\").join(process.env[\"RESEARCH_\"+\"HARNESS_STATE_DIR\"],\"name\"),\"SQ-322\\n\")'"
P59 command: ": ; printf \"SQ-322\\n\" >> research/decisions.md"
P59 reason: research-harness could not read this shell command well enough to judge it, and it names the research state or a .seal.key file, so it is denied. Split it into separate, simpler commands, or use the E
